DML.SELECT: SELECT element_type_id as "elementTypeId", element_type_state_id as "stateId", alarm_config_id as "alarmConfigId" FROM conf.element_state_alarms
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.element_state_alarms (element_type_id, element_type_state_id, alarm_config_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:elementTypeId, :stateId, :alarmConfigId, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE conf.element_state_alarms SET element_type_id = :elementTypeId, element_type_state_id = :stateId, alarm_config_id = :alarmConfigId, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE alarm_config_id = :alarmConfigId
